subject: Subprocessor roster & tenant routing impact for BlueBridge pilot
messages:
From: Allegra Porter <allegra.porter@bluebridge.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marcus Reid <marcus.reid@bluebridge.io>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: current subprocessor roster + routing for pilot

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for getting the pilot standing up with our team. Before we move to production we need the current subprocessor roster and a short explanation of how traffic for our tenant would be routed (i.e., whether any telemetry, logging, or model telemetry traverses third countries or is handled by third-party processors).

Specifically we need:
- A roster of all subprocessors involved in the product path (ingest, telemetry, observability, model hosting, CDNs).
- Country/region for each subprocessor and whether they act as a controller/processor.
- Any planned changes in the next 90 days.
- Evidence of encryption-in-transit and at-rest (KMS/HSM notes).
- A contact for escalation if we identify a residency concern.

If you can provide a brief CSV and any supporting docs (SOC2, KMS attestations, or a redacted DPA excerpt) that would be ideal. We are on a compressed schedule — can you get something over by end of day Thursday (9/16)?

Best,

Allegra Porter
Head of Security | BlueBridge
allegra.porter@bluebridge.io
+1 415-555-0247
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: current subprocessor roster + routing for pilot

Allegra — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Kim (legal/privacy) and Marissa (ops) and Naomi (trust) to pull the roster and confirm routing.

Internal note to the team: BlueBridge needs a CSV + short description of cross-border paths and any temporary processors used for analytics/observability. They asked for evidence (SOC2/KMS) and a 9/16 turnaround. I have attached the latest subprocessor matrix we maintain (draft, v2) — please populate with column headers: service, role, country, controller/processor, planned changes, evidence link.

Can someone own the primary response and attach the XLSX? Also flag any processors that would route EU traffic through non-EU countries. We should propose an onshore fallback if needed.

Thanks — Jordan

Summary of next steps (Marissa):
- I will export the roster from our registry and validate planned changes column.
- Kim, please confirm legal redlines and attach any DPA excerpt that is safe to share.
- Naomi, please confirm telemetry routing and whether any preview telemetry hits third-country analytics providers.

I expect a completed XLSX + short cover note that we can send to BlueBridge by end of day (Thu 9/16). If we find any processors that require onshore fallback we will propose an implementation note (config toggle + timeline).

Attaching: redwood_subprocessor_matrix_v2.pdf (internal, redacted)

-M

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: current subprocessor roster + routing for pilot

Uploading the roster now — attached as subprocessor_roster_2026-09-15.xlsx. Key points:
- The roster includes columns: service_name, role, primary_country, processor_type, contract_date, evidence_link.
- Observability telemetry for the pilot currently routes to EdgeSight Ltd (Ireland) and a downstream analytics aggregator in the UK. Neither currently routes through non-EEA jurisdictions for EU-region tenants.
- We have an opt-in onshore fallback for EU tenants via our onshore relay (will require minor config + opt-in flag). Estimated enablement: 5 business days after agreement.
- KMS: model serving keys are in our managed KMS (AWS KMS in US + EU key policy). For EU-only tenant residency we can place keys in an EU tenant KMS scope; we will need a short operational runbook (I can draft).

Attachments: subprocessor_roster_2026-09-15.xlsx
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBCDexample (evidence folder)

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

Proposed next step: 20-minute sync to confirm the opt-in path and the timeline. I can do 9/17 14:00 ET. Does that work?

-Jordan

Jordan — this is perfect, thank you. The roster and the Drive folder give us what we need to complete the internal assessment. 14:00 ET on 9/17 works for a quick sync; I sent a calendar invite.

A couple of small follow-ups we may cover on the call:
- Can you confirm whether audit logs for tenant configuration changes are retained for 12 months and whether they can be exported on request?
- If we opt into EU-only KMS scoping, will that affect model performance or require a separate model hosting instance?

I’ve also copied Marcus from our procurement team to track the DPA addendum.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.
